note: FTSE Russell September 2025 country classification review (published 2025-10-07): Vietnam to be reclassified from Frontier to Secondary Emerging effective 2026-09-21, subject to an interim review in March 2026. Paper 1 RQ4 break date (proposal).
FTSE Russell confirmed the reclassification after the March 2026 interim review (also https://vir.com.vn/ftse-russell-confirms-vietnam-market-reclassification-150165.html).
Reclassification effective from the market open on Monday 2026-09-21; index inclusion in tranches running into 2027.
